column1: Recent indicators point to modest growth in spending and production.  Job gains
have been robust in recent months, and the unemployment rate has remained low.
Inflation remains elevated, reflecting supply and demand imbalances related to the pandemic, higher food and energy prices, and broader price pressures.
Russia’s war against Ukraine is causing tremendous human and economic
hardship.  The war and related events are creating  additional upward pressure on
inflation and are weighing on global economic activity.
